title: When Source-Domain Validation Fails to Transfer: A Staged Study of Hyperparameter Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.29846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hyperparameters for an unseen domain are often selected using held-out examples from the available source domains. Withholding entire source domains during validation seems to better reflect deployment shift, but does this produce better selections on independent targets? We investigate this question through two complementary studies. A preliminary factorial experiment crosses particle swarm optimization and random search with pooled source validation and a leave-one-source-domain-out mean-minimum fitness on PACS and Multi-Domain Sentiment. The domain-aware fitness does not provide a consistent target advantage. We then separate selector development from confirmation using a shared pool of 64 configurations per task across four image benchmarks. translated_title: 当源域验证无法迁移时：超参数选择的阶段性研究
translated_abstract: 对于未见域的超参数选择，通常的做法是使用来自可用源域的保留样本进行验证。在验证过程中保留完整的源域似乎能更好地反映部署时的分布偏移，但这是否能在独立的目标域上带来更好的选择结果？我们通过两项互补的研究来探究这个问题。第一项初步因子实验在PACS和多域情感数据集上，将粒子群优化和随机搜索两种方法与池化源验证以及留一源域的平均最小适应度进行交叉组合。结果表明，域感知适应度并未带来一致的目标域优势。随后，我们进行了第二项研究，利用每个任务共享的64个配置池，在四个图像基准上将选择器的开发与确认阶段分离。基于VLCS和Office-Home上完整的目标性能景观，我们总结出一条规则：先通过池化源验证保留前16个配置，再选择最大的留一源域出……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究通过阶段性实验发现，在验证时保留完整源域的域感知适应度策略并不能为未见目标域的超参数选择带来一致的性能提升，并据此提出了先按池化源验证预筛选、再按留一源域出准则精选的两阶段超参数选择规则。
en_tdlr: Through a staged study, this paper finds that domain-aware fitness from withholding entire source domains during validation does not consistently improve hyperparameter selection on unseen target domains, and proposes a two-stage rule that pre-screens configurations by pooled source validation before applying leave-one-source-domain-out selection.
